symptom: The review UI smoke failed only between 00:00 and 03:00 UTC. The Commits fixture dated two commits 2 and 3 hours back, and the tab groups commits by the viewer's calendar day, so just after midnight both fell into Yesterday and no Today section rendered.
rule: Keep fixture dates that a view groups by calendar day inside their intended local day, and have the smoke pin a time zone at the edge hour instead of depending on when CI runs (principle 15).
